messages:
tim_sales: Quick sync — Orion trial gateway integration. Are we green for the demo on Thu? Need final owners + any lingering blockers (certs, CORS, signed RP, data mappings).

jordan_se: From SE side: app-level hooks + feature flags are wired. Embedding endpoint stub is done but we need the signed RP from security for the redirect flow.

maria_eng: I can take cert work and CORS headers. @alex_ops can you share CA ETA? Also will validate the redirect URI whitelist after cert is in.

alex_ops: Submitted cert request to internal CA at 10:12. Queue ~6-8 hours, might be sooner. Will post the CRT and the chain here when ready.

sarah_s: For the customer success criteria, we're tracking: 1) 95th latency <200ms at 50 RPS, 2) 99th <450ms, 3) embeddings cosine >= 0.92 vs baseline, 4) no PII in logs. Jordan — are the perf tests set up?

jordan_se: Yes — quick smoke run in staging now. Will push a 5-min load test and attach results. Also verifying embedding similarity with reference set.

qa_bot: Automated test run queued: gateway-integration-staging · expected duration 7m · triggered by jordan_se

maria_eng: Short checklist I'm tracking:
```
- request cert (alex_ops)
- set CORS allowed-origins (maria_eng)
- update redirect whitelist (maria_eng)
- feature flag rollout plan (jordan_se)
- data retention config (tim_sales + security)
- smoke & perf runs (jordan_se)
```

alex_ops: Cert issued at 15:03, pushed to S3 at s3://certs/orion/trial/chain.pem. Maria — can you pull and install to the test gateway? :thumbsup:

maria_eng: Got it, installing now. Will run a quick curl check: `curl -v https://orion-trial.internal/api/health` and report status.

jordan_se: Running smoke & perf now. First 1-min smoke looks good. Perf (5m @ 50 RPS) in progress.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: integration-gateway v2.3 -> staging (3/4 nodes healthy).

maria_eng: Health check returns 200 and TLS chain OK. CORS header present. Redirect whitelist updated.

sarah_s: Thanks — once perf results are in, if we meet the latency and embedding criteria we can confirm go/no-go for Thu demo. Also, Tim please confirm customer data retention settings are finalized.

tim_sales: I'll confirm with legal by EOD and update the doc: https://redwood.internal/sales/orion-trial/requirements. If everything passes, I'll schedule the final dry-run on Wed 11:00 PT.

jordan_se: Perf summary (attachment): 95th=180ms, 99th=420ms, error rate 0.03% — embedding similarity average 0.935. Looks good to me.

sarah_s: Awesome. Marking as green pending legal sign-off. :party-parrot:

qa_bot: Test run completed: gateway-integration-staging · status: success · artifacts: perf-summary-1778001890.json

tim_sales: Great work team. Will loop legal and confirm Wed dry-run. If anything new pops up, drop it here and I'll reassign owners.
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for sales channel; single-thread messages in chronological order
